message.content: The form area on the right side is a **success message** (not a form). It displays a confirmation with the heading "Баярлаа!" (which translates to "Thank you!" or similar in Mongolian), a checkmark icon, explanatory text about the JETOUR X70 Plus model, and a button labeled "Шинээр хусэлт" (likely "New request" or similar). This indicates a successful action (e.g., form submission) rather than an active form for input.
